data.title: Florine Beach Residences
data.about:
Florine Beach Residences by Sobha Realty offers a unique blend of luxury and tranquility. It features modern 1 to 2-bedroom apartments and 2 to 3-bedroom duplexes on the exclusive Siniya Island in Umm Al Quwain. Each apartment provides stunning panoramic sea views, allowing you to wake up to the gentle sounds of the waves, the beauty of serene mangroves, and the refreshing breeze of the Arabian Gulf.

This exquisite development offers a range of top-tier amenities, including an infinity swimming pool, a fully equipped fitness center, and beautifully landscaped parks. The community also boasts sky gardens and dedicated children’s play areas, creating a vibrant and family-friendly atmosphere. For those seeking adventure, the lagoon beach and water sports facilities provide exciting opportunities for outdoor exploration. The family golf course and floating pavilion further enhance the relaxed, leisurely lifestyle of island living, making it the perfect escape for both relaxation and recreation.

characteristics_module.title: Where Luxury Meets Nature – Florine Beach Residences in Siniya Island
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Premium Selection of Apartments: Modern 1, 2, and 3-bedroom residences designed with contemporary elegance for a hassle-free lifestyle.
  • Unobstructed 360-Degree Sea Views: Every apartment offers panoramic views of the Arabian Gulf, ensuring a tranquil living experience.
  • Exclusive Island Living: Located just 1.7 km from the mainland, combining the serenity of island life with easy access to Umm Al Quwain’s vibrant city center.
  • Eco-Friendly Environment: Discover an eco-park, mangrove trails, and lush natural reserves, promoting sustainable living and nature conservation.
  • Vibrant Social Scene: Waterfront cafés, marinas, and retail boulevards offer a dynamic mix of dining, entertainment, and leisure activities.
  • State-of-the-Art Amenities: An infinity pool, fitness center, landscaped parks, sky gardens, and children’s play areas are all designed for your comfort and convenience.
  • Adventure & Leisure: A lagoon beach with water sports, a family golf course, and a floating pavilion offer residents endless outdoor activities.

location_tile.title: Island Tranquility, City Convenience – Discover Your Coastal Escape
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Florine Beach Residences is on the serene Siniya Island in Umm Al Quwain, offering a luxurious beachfront lifestyle. Surrounded by the azure waters of the Arabian Gulf, lush mangroves, and pristine sandy beaches, this location is connected from the mainland via a 17km  magnificent bridge. Moreover, Siniyah Island is a sanctuary for diverse wildlife, including flamingos and seagulls, and features lush mangroves and pristine beaches, making it a haven for nature enthusiasts and historians alike.

  • 10 Minutes to Al Marjan Island
  • 30 Minutes to Sharjah
  • 50 Minutes to Dubai
